name: Upload
summary: Select files by clicking a drop zone or dragging onto it — then manage them as rows or picture tiles with per-item state.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-uploader> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. The DS V3 Upload is a FAMILY: `listtype` picks between a drop zone with file rows (`text`) and a grid of thumbnail tiles with a dashed add-box (`picture-card`); feed it `items` and each file renders with its status — normal, uploading (a progress bar driven by `percent`), error, or done — and a remove ✕. Hover, drag-over and the progress fill animate on the persistent zone/track (no subtree rebuild). Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper (listens for `change`/`remove`, JSON-stringifies `items`); Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Hover / drag
spec.value: border + accent tint color-primary / bg-accent (motion-mid, persistent zone)

spec.label: File row
spec.value: 1px border #E3E3E3, radius 8, file icon + name + remove ✕

spec.label: Uploading
spec.value: 4px pill progress track (split), color-primary fill, width animates (motion-slow)

spec.label: Error item
spec.value: border + text color-error #F5222D on bg-negative, warning glyph

spec.label: Picture-card
spec.value: 104px tiles + dashed add-box; add-box is the trigger

props.name: listtype
props.desc: Drop zone + file rows, or a grid of thumbnail tiles with a dashed add-box

props.name: items
props.desc: Managed files: [{ name, status?: 'normal'|'uploading'|'error'|'done', percent?, thumb? }]

props.name: multiple
props.desc: Allow selecting more than one file

props.name: maxcount
props.desc: Cap; the add trigger hides once items reach it

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Dims and disables the zone / add-box

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on select; read e.detail.files (File[])

props.name: remove
props.desc: Composed event when an item's ✕ is clicked

whenToUse.when: the user brings a file in — an image, a CSV, a document
capturing typed text, not a file
choosing a value from presets rather than importing

opinion.note: State what you accept in the zone copy and set `accept` to match. Drive `items[].status` from your upload lifecycle (uploading → done/error) and update `percent` as bytes land. Show the error reason near the failed row. Use `picture-card` for images, `text` for documents. Offer both click and drag — both are wired here.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Upload component-set taxonomy: *Upload* / Drag and drop (the drop zone), *Upload* / Upload List Item (text rows, states loading/success/error), Upload List Item / Picture (picture-card tiles + add-box). Token layer: dashed border-strong zone on white → color-primary border + bg-accent tint on hover/drag (persistent zone); rows on 1px border #E3E3E3 radius 8; error = color-error on bg-negative; done = color-success check; uploading = color-primary progress fill on a split track (width animates via motion-slow). Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Probe default state carries a done/uploading/error row set so item states are measurable.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-uploader[data-probe]');var sr=el.shadowRoot;var z=sr.querySelector('.zone');var zs=getComputedStyle(z);var errName=sr.querySelector('.row.error .name');var es=getComputedStyle(errName);var fill=sr.querySelector('.row .bar > i');var fs=fill?getComputedStyle(fill):null;var hasRemove=!!sr.querySelector('.rm[part="remove"]');return{radius:zs.borderTopLeftRadius,border:zs.borderTopColor,zoneColor:zs.color,errorColor:es.color,progressFill:fs?fs.backgroundColor:null,hasRemove:hasRemove};})()
